lines.t: Verse 1)
I’ve been crawling through the wreckage,
Breathing in the smoke I made.
Every lie I let consume me
Pulled me deeper in the haze.
But You tore into the darkness,
Shattered what I couldn’t face.
Now the fire in Your whisper
Burns the shadows into grace.
(Pre-Chorus)
I was breaking—
But You stepped into the fall.
I was fading—
Till Your voice cut through it all.
(Chorus)
And You crashed into my chaos like a raging flame,
Ripping all the chains I forged from fear and pain.
Every fracture in my soul You’re calling by name—
Oh, You pulled me back to life again.
When the darkness swore I’d never rise,
Your truth hit hard and opened my eyes.
(Verse 2)
I was clinging to the ruins,
Holding tight to every scar.
But Your mercy hit like thunder,
Splitting open who we are.
In the echo of Your promise,
I found strength inside the ache.
You rebuild me with a power
Nothing in this world can break.
(Pre-Chorus)
I was breaking—
But You stepped into the fall.
I was fading—
Till Your voice cut through it all.
(Chorus)
And You crashed into my chaos like a raging flame,
Ripping all the chains I forged from fear and pain.
Every fracture in my soul You’re calling by name—
Oh, You pulled me back to life again.
When the darkness swore I’d never rise,
Your truth hit hard and opened my eyes.
(Bridge – whispered to powerful)
(Whisper)
I hear You in the quiet…
I hear You in the break…
You pull me from the ruins…
You shake the earth awake…
I won’t run from Your fire—
Let it burn through everything fake!
(Final Chorus – heavier)
You crashed into my chaos like a raging flame,
Ripping every chain I forged from fear and pain.
In the ashes of my past, You’re calling my name—
And You pull me back to life again.
When the darkness swore I’d never rise,
Your love hit hard and opened my eyes.
